svg.text: Context only — no new action or outcome
Announced or underway — no result yet
Majority YES — or union sought authorisation
Majority NO / tie / <50% — or union did not seek it
Employer refuses work / locks workers out

text.tspan: Q2. Does the entry only add information to an existing
dispute, and doesn't include information on a new action

g.text: Q3. Is the entry about a protected action ballot?
Q4. Is this an employer-side action?

text.tspan: Q5. Is this a rally / protest / march where participants
are NOT withdrawing labour (workers still working)?
Q6. Has the industrial action been planned publicly,
but the specifics haven't been announced yet?

g.text: Q7. What form is the industrial action taking?

text.tspan: Flow Chart for Categorisation of Actions

tspan.tspan: Note - Q3 nuance: where a ballot fails but the union intended to authorise action (or
passes without union intent), classify by union intent. See Kewco (id 9108, 2/5
participation) and Gadaleta (id 9114, tied question) for split ballots.
Note - This is a rought guideline only put together recently. All entries may not always
be following these guidelines and may have been set inaccuratly. Also may designate
